QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Appearance
QuestInfo.0: As you're pushed back into the castle, you can hear screams coming from every direction, and the Giant Shadow that once lay hidden at the edge of the forest slowly approaches.
QuestInfo.1: Within the castle walls, it's bedlam, and you're barely holding off the monsters in front of you. If you have to take on the Giant Shadow here, there's not guarantee the villagers will make it out of this safely!
QuestInfo.2: Finally, after what felt like forever, the battle ended in the middle of Grim Vale.
